newsitem.title: UK: NWE oil products - gasoline firmer, fuel steady.
newsitem.headline: NWE oil products - gasoline firmer, fuel steady.

text.p: NWE oil products were mixed on Tuesday, traders said.
High sulphur fuel oil barges were steady and traded between $86.50 and $88 a tonne fob ARA.
Naphtha continued its gradual slippage dating back to late Friday's crude futures collapse, with August swaps retreating by $1.50 to around $185.00.

Gasoline, by contrast, rose modestly on greater perceived tightness in the north and the Med, with August swap deals confirming a $1 rise to around $190 and two barge deals at $192 indicating a similar physical gain.
August IPE gas oil firmed 75 cents a tonne to trade at $163.25. Spreads were steady, with an EN590 barge moving at $166.50 and a high sulphur done at $163.50.
